title: The sandbox, with no way out through settings or its shells
steps: Open <this Preview>/sandbox/webview by itself and run window.origin in its console: it says "null", as it does inside the app's frames.
Boards, Word count and the html-app samples draw and work as before.

A sandboxed extension that tries to write .common-ink/settings.json, your user settings or any extension's files is refused, even when allowed to change every file: test/browser/sandbox-escape.browser.ts shows it.
